request.business_problem: Support operations are spread across tribal knowledge: triage rules, reply quality checks and SLA tracking are all manual.
request.tasks: One plugin for support operations: a triage skill (category, urgency, draft reply), a reviewer subagent that checks a draft reply for risky promises and tone, and a business-hours SLA calculator tool, plus a skill that uses the calculator to tell an agent when a ticket is due.
request.required_output: Triage block, reviewer feedback list, and an SLA due time.
request.examples: Ticket: 'Seller never shipped my order 7788, want my money back.' Business hours 09:00-17:00 Mon-Fri, first response SLA 4 business hours.

smoke.prompt: Triage this ticket and tell me when the first response is due if it arrived 2026-03-06T16:30:00+00:00 (business hours 09:00-17:00 Mon-Fri, 4 business hours): 'My order 7788 never arrived, I want a refund.'
